Each fixture directory holds input.css, classes.txt (read through the @source line in input.css) and output.css.
Run from the repository root, in PowerShell or Git Bash:

.twind/bin/tailwindcss-windows-x64.exe -i twi/css/testdata/tailwind-4.3.3/hello/input.css -o twi/css/testdata/tailwind-4.3.3/hello/output.css
.twind/bin/tailwindcss-windows-x64.exe -i twi/css/testdata/tailwind-4.3.3/matrix/input.css -o twi/css/testdata/tailwind-4.3.3/matrix/output.css
